summary: AirTrail is a personal flight tracking system designed for logging and managing aviation journeys. Built using Node.js and distributed as a Docker container under the GPL-3.0 licence, it provides a self-hosted platform to record your travel history.
goodFor: Aviation enthusiasts and frequent flyers who want to maintain a private, self-hosted archive of their flight logs without relying on proprietary third-party services.
watchOut: The codebase has a moderate maintenance profile and you may find that it lacks the extensive ecosystem integrations of larger, commercial flight tracking platforms.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker and Node.js, you will typically need to map persistent volumes for your log data and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
